# OpenClaw Enterprise onboarding

> Public local-development onboarding maintained by redhat-et: a concise human guide, a detailed agent runbook and an execution brief for an operator's coding agent.

Scope: Apple Silicon Mac, approved Linux VM/engine and an owned k3d/K3s installation. The historical Colima/Docker platform and hosted-GLM tool task passed October 1, 2026 at affac2bfc1370e590e6da570bcaaad4a207c9f09. New exploration uses current upstream main and records the resolved SHA. An October 7 CSB run at 8023db20d5a7cfa84dbfe734d43898fc8cc354ce passed platform/database checks, HTTPS sign-in and a GPT-6 Luna nonce/arithmetic response with maximum effort configured; the same Agent/revision appeared in the console. Tools were not exercised. Browser access used an approved exact local certificate exception, without CA import/system trust claims. Sandbox Driver=none does not qualify OpenShell or production. Models run remotely.

Start with setup.md when asked to install. This index provides documentation discovery, not executable installation. Respect the operator's request, local instructions, company security policy, explicit model/budget and private credential handling. The direct first-Agent helper does not configure arbitrary AI gateways or reasoning effort.

## Setup

- [Agent setup brief](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/setup.md): execution order, inputs, ownership and success criteria.
- [Agent runbook](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/GETTING_STARTED_AGENTS.md): exact commands, verification and recovery.
- [Human quickstart](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/GETTING_STARTED.md): five concise steps.
- [Complete agent packet](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/llms-full.txt): generated brief plus runbook when one fetch is preferable.
- [Read-only preflight](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/setup-check.sh): inspect before running; checks prerequisites without installation or credentials.

## Optional

- [Repository instructions](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/AGENTS.md): contributor workflow and public-content boundaries.
- [2026 reference research](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/AGENT_SETUP_REFERENCES.md): 100k-star examples and format distinctions.
- [Local architecture](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/assets/architecture.svg): platform boundaries and remote inference.
- [Credential flow](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/assets/credential-flow.svg): model Secret/IAM and separate administrator/transport credentials.
- [Gateway configuration](https://redhat-et.github.io/openclaw-enterprise-onboarding/GETTING_STARTED_AGENTS.md#openai-compatible-gateway-configuration-gpt-6-luna-maximum-effort): GPT-6 Luna/maximum-effort native Configuration, protected model Secret and complete linked deployment flow; CSB HTTPS sign-in and nonce/arithmetic model response verified, filesystem tools not exercised.
- [Upstream local profile](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-enterprise/blob/main/docs/guides/deploy/local-kubernetes-development.md): current upstream runtime requirements; record the resolved source revision for each run.
